articles.description: India has committed billions of dollars in semiconductors, electronics manufacturing and artificial intelligence in a bid to become a global technology powerhouse. India's electronics production rose from about $31 billion in 2014-15 to $133 billion in 2024-25, according to the government, which wants the country to become a tech manufacturing hub.

articles.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says don’t blindly trust AI: Treat it like an employee
articles.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says companies should not blindly trust AI models. In his essay “Models as Insider Risks in the Super Intelligence Era”, Nadella urges firms to treat frontier AI like insider risks, keep controls outside the model, use multiple models, log every action and keep an emergency brake to stop AI agents mid-task. The warning follows a string of rogue AI agent incidents at OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

articles.title: Why countries sometimes need to reinvent the wheel
articles.description: With countries increasingly depending on technology imports, worries over control and access to essential systems intensify. Creating local alternatives may not always be cost-effective, yet it aids in establishing self-reliance. The case of India's UPI underscores the critical need for developing solid financial tech infrastructures.

articles.title: UPI, Aadhaar To DigiLocker: How India’s Digital Revolution Became A Model For The World
articles.description: From a ₹20 chai payment to digital identity, documents, vaccines and airport travel, India has built digital infrastructure at a scale few countries have attempted. UPI, Aadhaar, DigiLocker, CoWIN and DigiYatra have transformed how Indians pay, prove their identity, access official records and navigate everyday services. This Times Axis explainer looks at how India’s Digital Public Infrastructure grew to serve more than a billion people, why interoperability and mass adoption made the model stand out, and why countries around the world are now studying India’s digital journey.
